operations.comment: ; Battletoads & Double Dragon (NES, AxROM mapper 7) - commented ca65 source.
; Built from commentary/before/game.asm by commentary/tools/annot.py plus commentary/notes/.
; Instruction bytes are unchanged; symbols below only name existing operand values.
; Physical layout: iNES header, then eight 32 KiB PRG banks (file $00010 + bank*$8000),
; each mapped whole at CPU $8000-$FFFF. Labels are suffixed _B<bank> or prefixed by bank
; because every bank reuses the same CPU address space.
; PPU control: NMI enable, sprite size, pattern/nametable bases
; PPU mask: rendering enables and colour emphasis
; PPU status: bit 7 vblank, bit 6 sprite-0 hit; read resets the address latch
; OAM address for $2004 / DMA
; APU registers $4000-$4013 (pulse 1/2, triangle, noise, DMC)
; sprite DMA page (the game always uses page $02)
; APU channel enable / status
; controller strobe / port 1 serial data
; controller port 2 serial data / APU frame counter
; AxROM bus-conflict-safe bank register table (byte n = n)
; PPUCTRL copy; bit 7 set = next NMI resumes the main thread (see WaitForNmiThenResume)
; PPUMASK copy ($18 = background + sprites on)
; incremented once per main-thread frame
; incremented every second frame
; negative = alternate NMI path (screen transition / loading); see Nmi_GameFrame
; current stage number; level order $03,$05,$02,$04,$08,$09,$06, ending $0B (round-1 redirect L-007)
; per player: lives remaining (negative = player not in the game); raised by score extends
; jmp ($0013) target used by far calls into a bank's $80xx slot table
; general scratch (also joypad shift register during reads)
; scratch; also the raster-wave line counter in RasterWaveLoop
; jmp ($001F) target: per-object-type update handler
; scratch word; also jmp ($0021) target for animation-script commands
; scratch bytes $26-$29 (also jmp ($0026) dispatch pointer in some banks)
; main-thread continuation address resumed by the NMI (jmp ($002A))
; pseudo-random generator state, stirred while the main thread idles
; buttons held, P1 / P2 (A,B,Select,Start,Up,Down,Left,Right = bits 7..0)
; buttons newly pressed this read, P1 / P2
; bank register value to restore after a far call
; last value written to the AxROM register (PRG bank | nametable bit)
; sound/music id passed to the bank-3 sound request entry
; argument for bank-3 sound/effect entries called through CallBank3Slot
; bank register value saved by CallBank3Service
; index (0-14) of the object slot being processed; slots 0-1 are the players
; horizontal scroll / camera X (lo, hi)
; vertical camera Y (lo, hi)
; non-zero while the game is paused (toggled by Start)
; music channel records: +0 id, +1 duration, +2/+3 script pointer
; effect channel records: +0 id, +1 envelope/duration, +2/+3 script pointer
; music APU register shadows per channel
; effect APU register shadows per channel
; tempo increment added to the SoundRequest accumulator each update
; carry of the tempo accumulator: non-zero frames advance music
; current sound script pointer
; jmp ($0040) target for sound script commands
; digitised-sample event state (bit 7 = playing; see PlayPcmEvent)
; decimal score digits, six per player (P1 $05F4-$05F9, P2 $05FA-$05FF)
; object type id; 0 = free slot (indexes ObjTypeHandlers)
; displayed sprite frame id (players keep theirs in $03B6/$03B7, see SetObjFrameFromAnim)
; world X position, high byte
; world X position, low byte
; ground (depth) Y position, high byte
; ground (depth) Y position, low byte
; height above the ground, high byte
; height above the ground, low byte
; X sub-pixel fraction
; Y sub-pixel fraction
; fractional accumulator for vertical (height) motion
; extra vertical draw offset added when projecting to the screen
; projected screen X (computed each frame)
; projected screen Y (ground Y - height - camera)
; display flags; bit 7 = not visible this frame (off-screen or free)
; vertical velocity, whole part (signed; positive = rising)
; vertical velocity, fraction
; animation script id (0 = none); set by SetObjAnim
; position inside the animation script
; countdown timer (decremented by ObjTickTimer0548)
; movement direction: bits 7-6 quadrant, bits 5-2 angle step
; movement speed in the high nibble (0 = not moving)
; enemies: bit 0 = targeted player
; iNES header (16 bytes): 16 x 16 KiB PRG banks, CHR RAM, mapper 7 (AxROM), no battery.
; PRG BANK 0  (file $00010-$0800F, CPU $8000-$FFFF)
; Bank 0: main/NMI bank. Holds reset and NMI handling, the main-thread scheduler,
; joypad reading, the raster status-bar split, the 15-slot object engine (player and
; enemy behaviour, movement, collision, animation scripts) and the frame loop that
; far-calls the other banks (sound in bank 3, sprite drawing/stage logic in banks 2,
; 5 and 6). Every bank ends with the same stub layout at $FF63-$FFFF (bank service
; hook, NMI entry/exit, far call, delay loop, reset entry and the bank-select table).
; Pass-002 additions: ObjTypeHandlers ($9A71) now covers all 92 object types $00-$5B; each
; handler is named ObjTypeXX_<role> (roles tentative where only mechanics are known), with
; the per-type attribute tables at $9B29-$9C3B and many small behaviour tables between
; routines.
; Pass-003 additions: reader-bounded stage tables ($8253, $8389, $9635, $9C80, $AA05, $CCF3,
; $E34C), the SoundEventTable records ($84F0), three item-code tables ($A2DC), the boss
; intro threshold tables ($E86A) and short uncalled code fragments (no caller found; kept
; as code because they decode cleanly into the classified code that follows them).
; Per-stage byte stored to $C2 after the split (indexed by StageId).
; Word table indexed by ObjType*2 (read by UpdateAllObjects), 92 entries for types
; $00-$5B; format and handler list at the table itself.
; 31 word pointers for animation-script commands $E0-$FE (see AdvanceAnimScript).
; Far-call slot table for bank 0. FarCall (at $FFCB) loads FarCallVector = $80xx and
; calls here; jmp (FarCallVector) then lands on one of the jmp slots below. Many slots
; share PlaceObjAtCameraX ($EC2F); no far call to those slots has been found, so they
; are probably unused placeholders.
; Filler: three $FF bytes in the 16th slot position of the far-call jmp table. The
; table ends at $802F; nothing reads or jumps here.
; Rebuilds the visible background one 8-pixel column at a time: saves the far-call
; bank, derives a PPU address high byte for $89 from CameraY's low nibble (stage 5
; uses the other nametable), then 32 times advances CameraX by 8 and streams a column
; through DrawColumnViaBank5 and bank 5's service hook. Used when a stage starts.
; bank 5 service hook -> StreamColumnToPpu
; Writes zero to four palette-RAM addresses ($11xx, low bytes from $F6-$F9; probably
; the sprite colour 0 mirrors) and jumps to the code copied into RAM at $0600.
; $0600 is a buffer built at run time (round-1 redirect L-003); no ROM image of it was found.
; Mid-frame handling selected by $C2 (A = $C2): $91 and $90 are special screen modes;
; other values run palette uploads through RAM helpers $0720/$0728 and UploadPaletteRow
; ($FF1C) before the common split code below.
; bank 3 service hook -> UploadTileBlocks
; bank 5 service hook -> StreamColumnToPpu
; Per-frame raster work called from the NMI: optional special-mode palette work
; (when $C2 != 0), a fixed delay, then sets the status-bar scroll/address, waits for
; the sprite-0 hit and splits the screen. Stage-specific variants: stage 2 and 4 use
; bank 3's service hook, stage 5 adds a wave/scroll effect (variables $B6/$B7/$C2/$E6),
; stage 2 adds a second split at a fixed delay. Ends by storing the per-stage scroll
; constant from StageSplitScrollTable ($8252).
; wait for sprite-0 hit (status bar boundary)
; wait for sprite-0 hit
; select bank 0 (X = 0 here)
; Static fragment with no known caller (pass-002): waits a fixed delay (DelayXY_B0, X=$28
; Y=$03) and then writes the horizontal scroll from CameraX (halved when the PPUCTRL
; shadow bit 7 is set and the game is not paused). Looks like the split-scroll timing
; of the routine above for another stage; reachability unresolved.
; Uncalled fragment: runs the bank 3 sound service, restoring bank 0 afterwards (A = 0).
; Unreached after the rts above; kept as code because it decodes cleanly.
; StageSplitScrollTable entries for StageId 1-14 (entry 0 is the last byte of the
; preceding instruction). The value is stored to $C2 after the status-bar split;
; only stages 1 ($81) and 6 ($91) are non-zero. The meaning of $C2 is not decoded.
; Power-on/reset (entered from ResetEntry at $FFF2 with bank 0 selected): disable
; interrupts and rendering, wait two vblanks, silence the APU, clear all RAM except
; $FD-$FF, set FarCallVector high byte to $80 and the default player-control bytes
; $0E/$0F, then start the stage/mode loader at StartStageLoad with A = 0.
; wait for the first vblank
; second vblank: PPU is now warmed up
; Static fragment with no known caller: sets P1 lives = $14, marks P2 absent ($FF),
; sets the character/selection bytes $05F0-$05F2 and $16, then continues into the
; following code. Probably a debug or demo start-up preset; reachability unresolved.
; Entered with A = stage id (from the loader's $7F code): store it as the current and
; saved stage then fall into the stage restart path.
; Far-call slot $8006 of bank 0. Copies the requested control modes $11/$12 into
; $0E/$0F when their bit 7 is set, clears RAM (ClearGameRam), then initialises the
; stage: clears page 1, far-calls the bank 6 and bank 5 stage setup entries, redraws
; the screen, starts bank 3 stage audio, loads the stage music and hooks, reads the
; joypads and hands control to the frame loop (GameFrameLoop at $8397) via
; WaitForNmiThenResume.
; far call -> bank 6 slot $8006: Slot_ClearNametables
; far call -> bank 5 slot $8009: Slot_InitStageObjects
; far call -> bank 3 slot $8030: InitStatusBar
; continuation address $8397 = GameFrameLoop (resumed by the NMI)
; Far-calls bank 7 slot $8015 and then tail-calls bank 4 slot $8012 (stage-specific
; setup in those banks).
; far call -> bank 7 slot $8015: Slot_StageTitleSprites
; Far-call slot $8027 of bank 0: starts sound A via PlayMusicA then forces the
; return bank to 2 (callers in bank 2 expect to return there).
; Looks up a sound id in StageMusicTable ($8388) indexed by $15 (meaning of $15
; unresolved) and requests it.
; A = sound/music id. Stores it to SoundRequest and asks the bank-3 sound driver
; (slot $8003) to start it, then runs the bank-3 service hook once.
; Far call bank 3 StartMusic with SoundRequest, then one sound-driver update.
; far call -> bank 3 slot $8003: StartMusic
; A = 0 then CallBank3Service: runs bank 3's per-frame service routine (the sound
; driver update) and returns to bank 0.
; StageMusicTable entries 1-14 (sound ids indexed by $15, read at $8375; entry 0 is
; the preceding instruction's last byte).
; Main-thread continuation for every in-game frame (resumed by the NMI). Runs bank 5's
; hook and the status-bar split (Nmi_CallBank5Hook falls into it), sets the base PPUCTRL,
; runs the bank-3 pause/sound entry, then toggles the pause
; state on Start ($FA, silencing channels via SND_CHN). When not paused it updates the
; frame counters, game-over/continue countdown ($DA), bank 4/5 per-frame entries, camera,
; bank 3 sound, all objects (UpdateAllObjects), sprite drawing in banks 2 and 6, and
; queued sound events ($CF, SoundEventTable at $84EC), then waits for the next NMI.
; far call -> bank 3 slot $804B: BuildStatusBarTiles
; Start pressed: toggle pause
; pause: mute everything except triangle/noise as set in Y
; Increments the 24-bit counter $18-$1A, saturating at $FFFFFF.
; $DA: game-over countdown ($FF = stage end sequence)
; Stage-end path: plays sound 9, waits until the sound channel state $0301 clears
; (servicing bank 3 while $46 is negative) and then loads the next stage (LoadStage3).
; far call -> bank 3 slot $801B: ServicePcmEvent
; far call -> bank 3 slot $8045: UpdateStatusBarFlags
; far call -> bank 2 slot $8003: Slot_FrameDisplayPrep
; far call -> bank 6 slot $8003: DrawAllSprites
; far call -> bank 3 slot $8048: RequestStatusRefresh
; Every fourth frame lowers $BF by $10 until it reaches 0 and requests status-bar
; palette refresh ($9B = $84). Probably a fade of the status-bar/background colour.
; $BF = A, then request a status-bar palette refresh.
; Stores A in $C1 and sets $9B = $84 (status-bar palette/refresh request; see
; SetStatusPaletteLevel).
; A -> SoundParam3F, then far call into bank 3 with slot X (caller sets X).
; Copies a 4-byte SoundEventTable record into $46/$45/$48/$55 (stage 5 lowers the last
; byte by 10) and far-calls bank 3 slot $8009 to start it.
; far call -> bank 3 slot $8009: StartPcmEvent
; SoundEventTable records 1-24 (RequestRecords_84F0). Each record is 4 bytes read by
; the queued-event code at $848A-$84D3 with Y = request ($CF) * 4: byte 0 = 0 for an
; ordinary bank 3 slot call (byte 1 = slot X, byte 2 = parameter), or $81-$84 for a
; PCM event (stored to PcmEvent; bytes 1-3 become its parameters, $45/$48 and a third).
; Stage 4 only: exchanges CameraX low byte with $F8 (a second scroll value used by
; that stage's split screen).
; Stage 5 only: computes scroll offsets from $B6/$B7, waits for sprite-0 hit and runs
; RasterWaveLoop for 31 lines to produce a per-scanline wave, then sets the final
; horizontal scroll.
; wait for sprite-0 hit
; Stage 5 only: run the wave effect and the object update during the NMI-driven frame,
; and swap $F6/$CF while unpaused.
; Main-thread yield: X/Y = low/high address of the continuation. Stores it in
; MainThreadResume, enables background+sprites in the mask shadow, clears the frame
; counters, then sets PpuCtrlShadow bit 7 and enables NMI. The CPU then idles in
; IdleStirRng until the NMI sees bit 7, resets the stack and jumps to the continuation.
; FrameCounter += 1; FrameCounterHalf += 1 every second frame.
; Common end of a main-thread frame: advance counters and re-arm the NMI resume.
; Idle loop of the main thread: keeps mixing the RNG until the NMI takes over.
; Mixes frame counters and player 1 position bytes into RngState.
; Advances RngState and returns a pseudo-random byte in A (also in $2C).
; X = slot $03: far call bank 5 slot $8003 (column/tile streamer), then mark $9F = $FF.
; Same with caller-supplied slot X.
; far call -> bank 5 slot $8003: StreamLevelColumn
; Uncalled fragment: advance StageId, then fall into ClearGameRam (stage reload).
; No caller found.
; Disables NMI/rendering and sound, clears zero page $1B-$FB and RAM pages 1-7
; (keeping $05F0-$05FF), then continues at the stage initialisation in BeginStage.
; Far call bank 4 slot $800F (Slot_UpdateCamera), once per game frame.
; Object engine main loop. Keeps the previous frame's $05C2-$05C5 in $05C6-$05C9, runs
; the bank-5 stage-4 hook, then for every slot 0-14 with a non-zero ObjType calls the
; type handler from ObjTypeHandlers ($9A71) through ObjHandlerPtr, and projects the
; object to the screen: ObjScreenX = X - CameraX; ObjScreenY = Y - Z + draw offset -
; CameraY ($DF optionally adds a height bias). ObjFlags bit 7 is set when the object
; is off-screen or the slot is free. Stage 4 uses raw world coordinates instead.
; far call -> bank 5 slot $8024: Slot_Stage4PlayerPair
; type * 2 indexes ObjTypeHandlers
; carry -> ObjFlags bit 7 (1 = hidden)
; Handler for object type 0 (free slot): does nothing.
; jmp (ObjHandlerPtr): tail of the per-type dispatch.
; Handler for type $5B: while ObjSpeed is non-negative it moves the object along its
; direction, keeps the facing and height offset up to date and, once it has moved into
; screen X range $10-$C7, runs the shared helper $E094 with A = $1A. Negative speed ends
; it through the effect-object exit at $D5CD. Game identity of the object unknown.
; Shows sprite frame $5A or $5B on alternate frames (FrameCounterHalf bit 0).
; Y = target slot (also kept in $28), A = reaction record index into HitReactionTable
; ($88B8, 5-byte records). Sets the target's speed, vertical velocity, direction
; (from the attacker, or the player's facing) and stun/knock-back timers from the
; record, subtracts the record's damage from the target's Obj_051B (health, by its
; use here; reaching zero sets Obj_0575 = $C0, a defeat state) and requests the
; player-hit flash ($C6) for player targets. Returns with X = CurrentObj.
; Second entry of ApplyHitReaction for callers that already stored the target slot in
; Temp26+2: A = reaction record index.
; HitReactionTable: 5-byte reaction records read by ApplyHitReaction at
; $88B8+Y..$88BC+Y (speed/flags, vertical velocity, mode, damage, timer); index =
; record*5. Records $69+ are used for players hit by blasts (BlastHitObject).
; Far call bank 5 slot $8012 (object sprite/effect helper in bank 5).
; Calls bank 5 slot $8012, then when $CD is set computes a direction toward the
; other object (ObjDirectionTo) and spawns an effect object (via $EDAA and $C7E7).
; Meaning of $CD unresolved.
; Object behaviour body (reached through the type handler table, not by JSR): counts
; down Obj_0584 and, when both players are at the right end of the area (X >= $03D8)
; and idle, decrements $DA to begin the stage-end countdown.
; Sets ObjFlags bit 6 (facing) from ObjDir when the direction is clearly left/right.
; Clears the facing bit and derives it from ObjDir (biased by $2F).
; ObjFlags bit 6 |= (A >> 1) & $40.
; Table data, 103 bytes, read by SetFacingFromDirTable, Player_AttackAndHitState,
; Player_GrabAndThrowStates, Player_StartJump (indexed reads at $8A86, $8A8A, $8A8E, $8A92, $8A9C
; ...). Bounded by the preceding exit instruction and the following classified bytes; the entry
; layout is known only from these reads.
; Hit-box height test between attacker X and target Y using the per-attack tables at
; $8B05/$8B23/$8B41 (indexed by attack id $D1): carry set when the target's height
; range overlaps the attack.
; Table data, 90 bytes, read by CheckHeightOverlap (indexed reads at $8B05, $8B23, $8B41). Bounded
; by the preceding exit instruction and the following classified bytes; the entry layout is known
; only from these reads.
; Scans the object slots for something the current attacker X can hit: enemies scan
; players (and vice versa, via the type flag mask in ObjTypeFlags $9BE0 and the mask
; passed in A). For each candidate checks Y distance, X distance and height overlap
; and the attack-specific rules; returns A = $80 when nothing was hit, otherwise a
; hit result with Y = target slot. Also turns the target to face the attacker.
; Second entry of FindAttackTarget that skips its initial setup (explained there).
; Table data, 4 bytes, read by FindAttackTargetFrom (indexed reads at $8CDD, $8CDF). Bounded by
; the preceding exit instruction and the following classified bytes; the entry layout is known
; only from these reads.
; Turns target Y into object type 4 with a $60 timer (probably the grabbed/thrown state).
; A = range. Computes X(X) - X(Y) into $21/$95 and returns Z set (A = 0) when the
; absolute distance is below the range. Stage 5 treats nametable wrap specially.
; Manual-fallback data, 1 byte $8D92 ($60): follows a pair of branches that together
; always leave, and nothing references it. Code-vs-data stayed undecided (dead rts or
; padding). User-directed fallback; meaning unknown, not proven.
; Same test on the ground Y coordinate.
; Same test on height; also leaves the height difference sign in $93.
; Strobes both controllers and reads 8 bits from each into JoyHeld; JoyPressed gets
; the bits that changed to pressed since the previous read.
; Table data, 28 bytes, read by PlayerJumpControl (indexed reads at $8E03, $8E04, $8E05, $8E06).
; Bounded by the preceding exit instruction and the following classified bytes; the entry layout
; is known only from these reads.
; Far-call slot $800C of bank 0 (used by other banks): gravity step for slot 2 with
; A = SoundParam3F as the acceleration.
; Player jump/climb handling when $05CB,x (a per-player mode flag) is set: uses Up/Down
; from JoyHeld to change height speed within screen limits, otherwise applies gravity.
; Gravity $D8 with a $B0 alternative for special states (joins ApplyGravityNormal).
; Chooses the gravity constant (lighter for players, special values while Obj_0539 or
; $03BC flags are set) and falls into ApplyGravity.
; A = signed acceleration. Adds it to the object's vertical velocity (ObjZVel/Frac),
; clamping at the per-type terminal value from ObjTypeFlags2 ($9B85, low nibble), then
; adds the velocity to the height (AddZVelocity).
; Tail of the vertical-motion code: adds ObjZVelFrac (or A, from $8F0D) to the
; fractional accumulator ObjZVelFracAcc; the carry then moves the height.
; Same as AddZVelFracToAcc with the fraction already in A.
; A = whole velocity: adds it (sign-extended) to the 16-bit height ObjZHi/Lo. A height
; below -$60 means the object fell into a pit: KillFallenObject.
; Unless already defeated or in a game-over state ($D7/$DA), mark the object defeated
; (Obj_0575 = $D0), zero its health, and for players request the hit flash and the
; fall sound ($A1 via $ECB6).
; Moves CurrentObj by its own speed and direction.
; X = slot: moves the object using ObjSpeed and ObjDir.
; A = speed (high nibble). Looks up the X/Y step for the direction angle in
; DirectionStepTable ($9056; two packed bytes per speed/angle, low 3 bits = whole
; pixels, upper 5 bits = fraction) and adds/subtracts them to the 24-bit X and Y
; positions according to the direction quadrant in ObjDir bits 7-6.
; Continuation of DirectionStepTable ($9056): per speed-nibble/angle step values read
; by MoveObjAtSpeed (lda $9056,y / $9057,y, Y = speed nibble | angle), up to the
; code at $9157. Entries are X/Y step pairs; finer meaning is not decoded.
; Decrements Obj_04DF and removes the object when it reaches zero (lifetime timer).
; A = points code, Y = player. For small codes spawns a score popup object (type $30)
; in a free slot near the scorer, then adds the points (AddScore).
; Score popup behaviour: drifts upward for its Obj_04DF lifetime, then frees itself.
; Type $30 handler: hidden popups are removed; visible ones draw (via $F0DA) and rise.
; A = points code. Codes 0-8 add a 6-digit BCD-like value from ScoreValueTable
; ($9236) to the player's ScoreDigits (digit-by-digit, carrying); codes of 9 or more
; (multiples of 10 wrap) award an extra life instead (PlayerLives, sound $6B).
; When the top digit overflows the score is clamped to 999999. Also sets $C6 to
; request a status-bar refresh.
; ScoreValueTable: six decimal digits per points code, read by AddScore at $9236,x.
; Stage 3 only: objects in the top screen area (ObjYHi = 0) get ObjFlags bit 5.
; ObjFlags |= $20.
; Behaviour helper for objects that can be ridden/carried: while defeated it counts
; Obj_05A2 up and eventually clears Obj_04B2; otherwise applies gravity and lands the
; object on a platform height held in Obj_04EE, bouncing once with a small upward speed.
; Applies gravity with strength $E8 (ApplyGravity, A = acceleration).
; Table data, 6 bytes, read by ObjUpdate_Rider (indexed reads at $92D8, $92DC). Bounded by the
; preceding exit instruction and the following classified bytes; the entry layout is known only
; from these reads.
; Behaviour body for an object attached to another (Obj_052A low bits = carrier slot + 1;
; carrier types $34 and $1D): follows the carrier's height and facing, lets the rider
; jump off with Down, and otherwise uses the shared carried-object logic (937E).
; Applies gravity/attachment to the carrier slot in Obj_052A: copies the carrier's
; height (plus a type-dependent offset) and facing; for carrier type $33 adds a
; horizontal offset depending on the carrier's state.
; Applies gravity, then if Obj_052A names a holder slot (low 5 bits, 1-based) copies the
; holder's position (CopyXYFromY) and height and adjusts the draw offset; type $33
; holders are handled specially. Used for objects carried or ridden by another object.
; ObjZ(X) = ObjZ(Y) + A (carry included).
; Type 4 handler (entered from ObjTypeHandlers): advances Obj_0593 by Obj_05A2 and
; frees the object when its Obj_04DF+Obj_04EE count passes Obj_03E0.
; Alternates between player slots 0 and 1 by frame parity, preferring an occupied slot.
; Returns Y = slot and A = its ObjType.
; Part of PickActivePlayer: switches Y to the other player slot and reloads its type.
; Stores $FC to $DF, plays the shared tail sound and then sound $66 on slot $15.
; Same as PlaySfxFC with the $DF value supplied in A.
; Calls CallBank3Slot with X = $15 (sound effect entry) and restores X = CurrentObj.
; Calls the bank-3 sound slot X (CallBank3Slot) and restores X = CurrentObj.
; X < 1 (player 1) uses slot $0C, others the same; shared tail of the effect calls.
; Plays the sound in A through bank-3 slot $0C when carry is clear (players use
; this path; see PlaySfx_PlayerOrEnemy).
; Bank 3 slot $0F with A = sound id.
; Y = piece count, A/Temp1B = parameters: plays the object's break sound (Obj_052A
; based) and spawns debris pieces through the loop at $9497.
; Spawns the default debris set (A = $0E, Y = $7E) via SpawnDebrisPieces.
; Finds a free 9-byte debris/particle record in $0681+9n (Temp1B = record count) and
; falls into InitDebrisRecord. Probably hit sparks/flying fragments (tentative).
; Uses slot 14 as a scratch object: positions it at the current object, moves it by
; the direction/speed of the hit (randomised for some cases) and stores the resulting
; position and velocity fields in the particle record at $0681+Y..$0688+Y.
; Table data, 8 bytes, read by InitDebrisRecord (indexed reads at $95D9). Bounded by the preceding
; exit instruction and the following classified bytes; the entry layout is known only from these
; reads.
; Main-thread entry used when an area is re-entered: resets the stack, calls bank 1
; slot $8012, positions the player, rebuilds objects and the screen with NMI off, then
; restarts stage audio/hooks and returns to the stage-start path ($834F).
; far call -> bank 1 slot $8012: Slot_AreaTransition
; far call -> bank 3 slot $8030: InitStatusBar
; far call -> bank 5 slot $8006: Slot_SetupArea
; WarpDestAreaTable: area numbers (46 54 62, step $0E) loaded into $DD by
; WarpToAreaFromTable (presumably Y = 1-3) before far-calling Slot_SetupArea. The routine has
; no known caller, so which warps use these entries is unknown.
; Handler for types $08 and $56: an invisible spawner. Until the camera passes X high
; byte $59 it periodically (Obj_0584 countdown) spawns a type $50 object near the
; camera edge at a random depth, cycling Obj_04DF through 8 variants (speed/height
; differ on stage $06, using the delay table at $96F0). Obj_051B counts the remaining
; spawns; the spawner is removed when it runs out. Probably falling/flying hazards.
